policies.firstPair: Both rivers; first death waits for the other. Each later death schedules one selected river.
policies.selection: One 1-100 saved-RNG draw on every death, including the first; 50 threshold normally, 25/75 after four repeated selections.
policies.shrineSourceBinding: 90/0.3/2 are retained effect-slot candidates; active native callbacks and radius are unverified.
policies.shrineVision: Existing team sight, terrain and brush rules; no unobstructed native claim.
policies.shrineSpeed: Allied living champions, additive with percentage speed bonuses; combat gating is not yet implemented.
policies.presentation: Source idle/run2/flee/stun/spawn, cloned run alias, held below-ground hide for burial and corpse; local procedural shrine ring/minimap marker.

unit.scope: Includes 2400-tick traversal of every waypoint in both river bounds, exact continuations, thresholds, ownership/deadline rejection, rewards, both-team shrine/linger/death and regeneration. A root crossing a graze deadline now cleans the clock and remains restorable.
